planner.note: Deployed Pendulum MPC maximises imagined open-loop H=16 return over 16 sequences, then executes only the first action and replans.

evidence_matrix.question: Does exact H=16 sequence selection miss 64-step value?
evidence_matrix.label: short_objective_misses_practical_value
evidence_matrix.established: Complete-plan H=16 return is not 64-step value under common-zero continuation
evidence_matrix.unknown: Not receding first-action control; not 200-step episodes

evidence_matrix.question: Does better prediction rank candidates worse?
evidence_matrix.primary: student Spearman 0.680 vs zero 0.620; selected16 regret 3.905 vs 5.218
evidence_matrix.label: evaluation_variance / planning_metrics_agree
evidence_matrix.established: Student ranks H=16 candidates better on those states; episode return still favored zero on fresh physics
evidence_matrix.unknown: One-shot ranking is not receding 200-step control

evidence_matrix.question: Is the best 16-sequence first action optimal for first-action+replan?
evidence_matrix.label: sequence_first_action_misalignment_detected
evidence_matrix.established: Complete-plan value ≠ first-action value under zero-replanning
evidence_matrix.unknown: H=16 selected first-action regret vs best-of-3 is exploratory (~15.3), not a 200-step controller test

evidence_matrix.question: Does a source-trained linear Q beat H=16 on 64-step first-action return?
evidence_matrix.unit: ten decoders; development phase-50 visited states
evidence_matrix.label: aligned_first_action_gain_not_established
evidence_matrix.established: This 15-coefficient Q did not beat H=16 on 64-step first-action+zero-replan
evidence_matrix.unknown: Never deployed as a 200-step receding controller; RMSE 107.5 on development

evidence_matrix.question: Does action×observation Q beat H=16 on 64-step first-action return?
evidence_matrix.label: action_conditioned_gain_not_established
evidence_matrix.established: Larger state-action Q still did not beat H=16 on the same 64-step intervention
evidence_matrix.unknown: Same 64-step visited-state screen, not full-episode receding

evidence_matrix.question: Does an endpoint readout or scalar correction improve selection?
evidence_matrix.label: local_first_action_inconclusive / scalar_selection_gain_not_established
evidence_matrix.established: Score correction of complete 16-sequences did not establish better choices
evidence_matrix.unknown: Correction was not a Bellman backup of receding value

evidence_matrix.question: Does executing the selected 16-plan beat receding on 16-step return?
evidence_matrix.label: replan_consistency_not_established
evidence_matrix.established: 16-step commit vs recede is inconclusive; search-noise switch 0.500

evidence_matrix.question: Is student first-action worse than zero at late same states?
evidence_matrix.label: action_quality_not_separated

evidence_matrix.question: Does nested H=8 receding beat archived H=16 on 200-step return?
evidence_matrix.label: shorter_horizon_hurts_episode_return
evidence_matrix.established: Shortening the open-loop objective hurt complete-episode control while one-step MAE stayed small
evidence_matrix.unknown: Does a Bellman first-action backup of H=16 value beat H=16 receding?

explanation_rank.name: incorrect_objective
explanation_rank.why: Planner maximises open-loop sequence return then executes one action. Exact H=16 misses 64-step value; sequence-best first action is not receding-best; nested H=8 hurt 200-step return.

explanation_rank.name: insufficient_or_misaligned_learning_signal
explanation_rank.why: Fitted Q/V used 64-step zero-replan labels at isolated visited states, never 200-step same-policy receding returns. Development RMSE ~96–108.

explanation_rank.name: inaccurate_dynamics
explanation_rank.why: H=16 teacher-forced angvel MAE ~1.93, but H=8 (less compounding) hurt control. One-step MAE ~0.09 stayed small while episodes lost ~174 points.

explanation_rank.name: limited_search
explanation_rank.why: Search-noise first-action switch 0.500. Same 16×16 set made H=16 beat H=8, so objective horizon dominated candidate-set identity in that test.

explanation_rank.name: failure_to_adapt_when_physics_change
explanation_rank.why: H=8 hurt both student and zero on development. Student-minus-zero 200-step late-episode return included 0. Negative transfer remains a separate closed confirmation result.

competing.name: planning_objective_mismatch
competing.why: Open-loop 16-plan value is not first-action value under replanning. Registered: 64-step complete-plan regret 34.685; sequence-to-first-action gap 20.254; nested H=8 hurt 200-step return. The deployed rule still maximises the former.

competing.name: state_dependent_action_value_estimation
competing.why: Linear and action-conditioned Q failed a 64-step zero-replan screen (RMSE ~96–108). That does not prove a larger network is required; those labels were not receding 200-step returns. Capacity was already increased once and still failed.

competing.name: policy_induced_distribution_shift
competing.why: Late executed-error growth was not established. Recede-versus-commit on 16-step return includes 0. H=8 hurt complete episodes, which is compatible with H1 without isolating progressive post-choice state shift. Do not treat H3 as demonstrated.

note: No environment collection. Nested H=8 result and closed Q/V screens are unchanged.
